sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm: two full-volume packages at 42 days
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand that capacity is tight and that you prioritise firm, long-term commitments. We are ready to offer exactly that.

We propose a choice of two packages. Both are at 42 days lead time, DAP and 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01:

A: 23,400 units/year, 24 months, EUR 30.25/unit.
B: 23,400 units/year, 36 months, EUR 29.89/unit.

In either package, the annual quantity would be binding for the agreed term.

Our September orders for this seal were at EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10).

Our September forecast was 21,310 units (fc:340010@2026-09). That is a planning figure, distinct from the binding 23,400/year requirement we are proposing here.

Which package can your planning support at 42 days? We look forward to your view.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm: two full-volume packages at 42 days
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

We can accommodate the 42-day lead time for 23,400 units over 24 months at a unit price of EUR 33.50. If a lower price is required, we will need to extend the lead time. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Two full-volume, three-year packages for the 24 mm seal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming 42 days for the full 23,400 units. We note that a lower price would need a longer lead time, and we are prepared to work with that.

We propose a choice of two new packages. Both are 23,400 units/year binding, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01:

A: 36 months, 56 days, EUR 30.90/unit.
B: 36 months, 42 days, EUR 31.60/unit.

Compared with our earlier proposals, Option A adds a third committed year and the longer lead time you indicated, at a higher price. Option B raises our three-year price while keeping 42 days. Both are new proposals that require your agreement.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is not your disclosed cost.

Would you ask your manager to approve this complete package as a commercial exception, with you remaining our lead?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Two full-volume, three-year packages for the 24 mm seal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

As Segment Manager, I have reviewed your cost estimate and your request for a commercial exception. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We can accommodate the 56-day lead time and 36-month contract for 23,400 units at a unit price of EUR 31.40. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer reflects the maximum flexibility we can provide under the requested terms.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
